title: A mega recognition memory study of 2897 disyllabic words
authors: Michael J. Cortese, Daniel P. McCarty, Jocelyn Schock
caption_short: Schematic of the megastudy: 30 study-test cycles per participant, each with 50 study words (2 s each or self-paced) followed by 100 test words (50 studied, 50 new) judged old or new.
notes: Drawn by us. The article is not open access (Unpaywall: is_oa false) and no author manuscript was found, so its figures could not be checked; the design shown is taken from the abstract (Europe PMC, PMID 25220011: 120 subjects, 3000 disyllabic words, 30 study lists of 50 words, 30 test lists of 100 words, 60 subjects with 2000 ms per item and 60 self-paced) and from the released trial file (100 test words per list, 50 studied and 50 new). Example words are illustrative and not taken from the data. Rendered with Pillow (scripts/schem_words.py).
